format: DanceFlow person types and relationship roles
requirement: The seven person types and relationship roles (dancer, student, professional, instructor, team_member, alternate, other) are DanceFlow roster vocabulary. They stay distinct from entry relationship roles, actual dance roles (leader/follower) and governing-body eligibility statuses. 'Instructor' establishes no credential; 'Alternate' is a roster classification, not the NDCA formation reserve rule (XII.C.7, NOT IMPLEMENTED).
enforcement_point: Wording constant; not yet shown in the public registration builder (that file is changed by the OD-02/OD-03 PRs). Identifiers, validation and pricing are untouched.
